proves.claim: collectScreenshots lists the job's screenshots directory and returns each png with path, bytes, sha256 and base64, or an empty list when the directory is absent.

runner.io-worker-screenshots.collects-pn.why: Without it the job screenshots could fail to reach the receipt with no test naming what it proved.

proves.claim: a screenshot set over SCREENSHOT_MAX_BYTES returns no files and a refusal naming the total bytes, with no file read.

runner.io-worker-screenshots.refuses-ove.why: Without it an oversize screenshot folder could be read whole into the worker with no test naming what it proved.
